description.all-sourced: Everything sourced. What is in the deck is listed below.
description.bought-it: Bought it already? Record it as being in the deck.
description.card-search: Full Scryfall syntax, e.g. bolt set:2ed or t:goblin cmc<=2. Drag a hit down into the collection — or just click it.
description.collection-gone: This collection is gone. It may have been deleted in another tab.
description.collections: Every collection is a real place cards live in: a crate, a binder, a shelf.
description.color-identity: Color identity, so symbols in the rules text count too.
description.color-spread: How many colors a card has.
description.deck-collection-empty: Nothing from your collection is sleeved up in this deck yet.
description.delete-cards_one: 1 copy of “{{name}}” is deleted from the deck and from the inventory. Putting them back on a shelf is the other button.
description.delete-cards_other: {{count}} copies of “{{name}}” are deleted from the deck and from the inventory. Putting them back on a shelf is the other button.
description.delete-collection: “{{name}}” and every card filed in it will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
description.delete-entry: “{{name}}” will be removed from this collection.
description.description: What is this collection for? Optionally shown above the card list.
description.dissolve-deck: “{{name}}” holds {{count}} cards. They go back into the collections they came from.
description.drift: The decklist says what the deck should be, the deck collection what is actually lying in it. This is the difference.
description.drift-not-in-deck: These cards are in the deck but no longer on the list at all. They belong back on a shelf.
description.drift-other-printing: These copies are in the deck, but the list asks for another print or finish. Either follow the list or swap the cards.
description.drift-pending: These copies are not in the deck: take them from a collection or buy them.
description.drift-surplus: More copies of these cards are in the deck than the list asks for.
description.formats: Cards that are legal in each format.
description.graph-filter: Filters through the synergy graph: what cards produce, consume or can do — the questions Scryfall cannot answer.
description.graph-filter-unavailable: The graph service is not answering right now.
description.graph-mode: Searching through the graph — Scryfall syntax does not apply here.
description.import: A CSV export from Moxfield, Archidekt, Deckbox or ManaBox. Columns are recognised by their headers.
description.import-done: Filed {{cards}} cards: {{created}} new stacks, {{merged}} existing ones topped up.
description.import-nothing-read: No card rows recognised. Columns found: {{columns}}
description.in-deck: Cards that are really in the deck, sorted by the collection they came from.
description.keywords: The ten most common rules keywords.
description.mana-curve: Lands excluded, everything from 7 up pooled.
description.marker: The colour and pictogram the collection is recognised by in the overview.
description.marker-preview: This is how the collection looks in the overview.
description.name: Ideally whatever is written on the collection.
description.no-collections: Create a collection to start filing cards.
description.no-copies-owned: This card is in none of your collections.
description.no-deck-collection: Give this deck a collection to move cards out of your collections into it, and to sort them back later.
description.no-entries: No cards filed in this collection yet.
description.no-slots: This deck lists no cards yet.
description.no-statistics: File some cards and this is where you see what the collection is made of.
description.nothing-on-loan: No card of this collection is sleeved up in a deck right now.
description.other-finish-available: You own {{count}} more in the other finish.
description.other-printing-available: You own {{count}} more in another printing.
description.pips: Colored mana symbols in the costs. Hybrids count for both colors.
description.purchase-price: Per copy, in euro. Leave empty when unknown.
description.purchase-vs-market: One dot per stack, at most the 250 most valuable. The diagonal is break-even.
description.search-constraints: Click one to switch it off.
description.share-link: Anyone holding this link can see the collection. Purchase prices stay hidden.
description.share-link-dead: This link does not work any more. Ask whoever shared it for a new one.
description.shared-empty: There are no cards in this collection.
description.sourcing: What the deck list asks for and is not in the deck yet. Take it out of a collection, or record that you bought it.
description.split-entry: When part of a stack no longer matches the rest — say one of four copies got played — it becomes a stack of its own.
description.timeline: Cumulative by acquisition date. Value uses today's prices.
description.visibility-private: Only you can see this collection.
description.visibility-unlisted: Visible to anyone with the link, nobody else.
description.wants-list: Everything the deck is still short of, as plain text. Paste it into Cardmarket's wants list import — without editions, so you get the cheapest copy.
description.wants-with-available: Takes in cards you own but have not sleeved into the deck yet, which turns the list into a note for the shelf.
description.years: By the release date of the printing, not of the card.

heading.drift_one: The list and the collection differ on 1 card
heading.drift_other: The list and the collection differ on {{count}} cards
heading.no-deck-collection: This deck holds no cards yet

label.drift-not-in-deck_one: 1 copy is not on the list
label.drift-not-in-deck_other: {{count}} copies are not on the list
label.import-resolving: Looking the cards up in the catalog
label.name: Name
label.wants-with-available: Also what is still in your collections

toast.deck-collection-created: The deck keeps a collection now
toast.deck-filled: {{count}} cards recorded as being in the deck
toast.invalid-price: That is not a valid price.
toast.invalid-split: At least one copy has to move out, and fewer than the stack holds.
toast.not-a-card-link: That was not a Scryfall card link.
toast.unknown-card-link: Scryfall does not know that card.
